posts.title: Mixed-Version Deploys Are the Real Migration Test
posts.summary: A green migration against one freshly deployed application version misses the risky interval. Define the rollout states that can coexist, test reads and writes in each state, then remove compatibility only after the old paths are truly gone.

posts.title: An API Deprecation Needs a Removal Test
posts.summary: Deprecations finish when the old behavior can be removed safely. Add contract checks and usage evidence that exercise that future state before the deadline.
